question: Should OpenAI-compatible classification remain strictly local-only, and should the generic image export capability be separated from this classifier PR?
rationale: Repository policy establishes privacy goals but does not authorize arbitrary remote endpoints or confirm that a new write-capable export command belongs in this feature, so automation cannot choose those boundaries safely.

options.title: Keep it local and narrow
options.body: Restrict classifier endpoints to local hosts and move export into a separate PR with complete Photos-package destination protection.

options.title: Support explicit remote mode
options.body: Allow non-local endpoints only behind a clearly named cloud opt-in that records the destination and exactly which assets or derivatives are transmitted, while separately hardening export.

options.title: Accept the broad branch
options.body: Approve arbitrary endpoints and bundled export as intentional product behavior, explicitly owning the additional privacy and library-integrity risk.

recommendation.title: Keep it local and narrow
recommendation.body: Restrict classifier endpoints to local hosts and move export into a separate PR with complete Photos-package destination protection.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository policy names Josh as the product-vision authority and specifically centers private-data handling decisions.
